latest_accounts.internal_title: Consolidated Provisional Group Statutory Accounts for the year ended 31 July 2025
latest_accounts.source_preservation_rule: The supplied PDF is preserved unchanged. Independent technical clarifications are published separately.

reported_parent_and_sole_shareholder_of: Matkator, S.L. (source literal; repository canonical form: Matkator, S.L.U.)
directors_statements_attributed.reported_context: Hotel Sun Park / MYND Yaiza and associated hotel, property, commercial, creditor, income and recovery interests
directors_statements_attributed.valuation_position: The directors describe the £1 underlying group asset interest as symbolic, prudential, provisional and non-valuation-based, and state an intention to update values when fuller evidence and forensic work permit.
directors_statements_attributed.status: These are filed directors' statements, not Companies House findings, an audit opinion or a judicial determination.

accounting_interpretation_control.canonical_statement: The £1 reported by Aweswell Limited is the directors' provisional, prudential and non-valuation carrying presentation under constrained reporting conditions. It is not evidence that Sun Park / MYND Yaiza, the hotel business, the group, any property interest, operating income, creditor position, recovery claim or damages claim had a market, fair, recoverable, commercial or patrimonial value of £1 or zero. It is not a waiver, abandonment, admission, estoppel, recovery cap, insolvency finding, culpability finding or judicial determination. Any replacement or expansion of the carrying amount must comply with the applicable asset-specific recognition, control, classification and reliable-measurement requirements and with the higher threshold applicable to contingent recoveries.

recognition_path.rule: Establish exact reporting-entity title or control, consolidation perimeter, classification and reliable measurement before recognition or revaluation.
Recognise earned, attributable and reliably measurable income in the correct entity and period. Future projected income is not booked wholesale as a present asset.
evidence: account of profits or receivable analysis

recognition_path.rule: Do not recognise a contingent asset until inflow is virtually certain; disclose a probable but not virtually certain inflow when practicable. Apply the specific virtually-certain threshold to third-party compensation for impaired, lost or surrendered property.
Distinguish prior-period error correction, change in estimate, revaluation and recognition in a later period. A later recovery is not automatically a restatement of the 2025 accounts.

incremental_bridge: apply the relevant probability or virtual-certainty threshold
recognise or disclose in the correct period
reconcile each increment from the £1 presentation

technical_citation_clarification.issue: The filed discussion of prudence refers to FRS 102 paragraphs 17.21-17.23.
technical_citation_clarification.clarification: In the January 2022 edition, paragraphs 17.21-17.23 address useful life and depreciation methods, not the general prudence principle.
technical_citation_clarification.status: Independent repository technical note; not an audit opinion and not an amendment of the filed PDF.

reporting constraints and reservation of rights
the parent's stated funding, creditor, investor and recovery position
does_not_by_itself: replace LPB's Spanish annual accounts during liquidation

third_party_misuse_control.test: A use is materially incomplete or potentially misleading when it converts the £1 carrying presentation into a substantive statement about worth, solvency, ownership, loss, waiver, standing, liability or damages while omitting the provisional and non-valuation qualification.
unsupported_examples: the group assets were worth zero or £1
the accounts admit no loss or damages
the accounts waive title, income or recovery
the accounts prove LPB had no economic value
Companies House confirmed the hotel value
response_steps: preserve the exact statement and source
distinguish carrying amount, valuation and contingent-claim recognition
refer material litigation, lending, tax, regulatory or reputational uses to legal and accounting advisers
third_party_misuse_control.intent_rule: Do not attribute bad faith or deliberate misuse without evidence of intent.

source_boundaries: Companies House register facts and filing events are separated from directors' statements within the filing.
Companies House does not independently verify the asserted Spanish recovery position or values.
The £1 presentation is not represented as a market valuation, recovery cap or judicial finding.
Full unencumbered ownership, hotel-income entitlement and damages are recovery positions requiring title, control, quantum and forum-specific proof.
